_about: Jacob Abbott's first Rollo books, stories of a boy's work, play and learning: Rollo at Work, Rollo at Play, Rollo's Experiments, Rollo's Museum. Rollo's Experiments and Rollo's Museum (both entered for copyright in 1839) print only "by the author of Rollo learning to talk" and the rest; the attribution to Abbott is the Gutenberg catalogue's. His Makers of History biographies, the Rollo travel books and the Franconia stories are left for now. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-10: Adam asked the project to keep going until he stops it; Adam may veto).
